NetworkHandle does not exist (development only) Module not yet initialized (development only) Description Enables the NM PDU transmission ability. For that purpose <BusNm>_EnableCommunication shall be called in case NmBusType is not set to NM_BUSNM_LOCALNM. (e.g. CanNm_Enable Communication function is called if channel is configured as CAN). Available via Nm.h
